description: Transport en commun LIA - Arrêts is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Le Havre Seine Métropole. Stops in the public transit system. Judgments are of two types: with a shematic position or a real position. Coverage: Le Havre Seine Métropole. The portal shows the English title as "Public transport LIA - Stops" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Le Havre Seine Métropole. Its keywords include arrets, caux, autobus, ouvertes, pays, dame. The listing shows 5 download or service links in SHP, WFS, DXF, KMZ. The listing shows 2024-04-09 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
